source_experiment: E132d (5-head set ablation with a 30-draw null)
why_it_matters: A single-head effect inside the k=1 floor has TWO possible causes and this file separates them: ablate the SET and place it against the set-size null. The COPY circuit clears at the 0th percentile -- individually invisible, collectively enormous, a genuine resolution limit. The READ candidates sit at the 46.7th -- indistinguishable from five random heads, so for them there is no hidden effect to resolve.
founding_incident: E132c used the single random draw at +0.8728 as its null. It is the 96.7th percentile of the proper 30-draw null. That is why E132c is marked INADMISSIBLE and why this project exists.
